title: Puglian Italian Fest
description: A journey through the Apulian Art & Traditions. Ten days of Food, Music, Cinema, Culture and Comedy in the heart of London. The Puglian Italian Fest is promoted by Pugliesi nel Mondo – UK, which began its activities in London a few years ago. The organisation has been active in Italy for over 15 years, organising the well-known "Pugliesi nel Mondo Awards", which celebrate outstanding Apulians around the world.
longDescription: There comes a moment when we feel the need to return to our roots. Where crystal-clear emerald waters calm the soul. Where white and ochre stones whisper stories of art and ancient history.

The rhythm of the pizzica reminds us how Mediterranean music keeps the passion of Southern Italy alive. The same passion that lives in warm focaccia, fresh orecchiette and flavours created with dedication and love.
A land of endless golden wheat, vineyards and olive groves under the southern sun. Puglia is more than a place: it is a feeling.
Join us at the Puglian Italian Fest and experience a journey through Apulian art and traditions!

programme.title: Amaraterra - Pizzica & Folk Tales Night
longDescription: An evening dedicated to Apulian folk music in the heart of London. Let yourself be transported by the ancestral rhythms of the pizzica and taranta, accompanied by tales and stornelli from the tradition.
Amaraterra will bring to the Jamboree stage the energy and passion of Southern Italian music, in a sonic journey through pizzica, tarantella and folk tales.
Additional details will be published soon.

programme.title: CinemaItaliaUK: Bell'Epokèr
longDescription: Screening of the film Bell'Epokèr by Apulian director Nico Cirasola, as part of the Cinema Italia UK series.
A work that blends cabaret and entertainment between Apulian tradition and the Belle Époque, with an ironic and poetic look at Southern culture.
Additional details will be published soon.

programme.title: Puglia through the lens
programme.venue: Estorick Collection of Modern Italian Art
programme.description: Talk & Photography with Dr. Angelo Maggi.
longDescription: Puglia has long been one of the most beloved Italian regions for photographers, architects and scholars, both Italian and international. Its visual power – made of light, stone, open horizons and rural Mediterranean architecture – has generated an extraordinary iconographic heritage. Numerous photobooks and research projects bear witness to how this territory has welcomed the gaze of great masters of photography, capable of capturing its vitality through fresh and profoundly contemporary visual perspectives.

The Murgia dei Trulli as a meeting point between timeless architecture and human-shaped landscape. Rural constructions – trulli, masserie, jazzi, dry stone walls – become keys to understanding a Mediterranean world made of ancient gestures, skilled building techniques and a harmonious relationship between man and nature.

The talk will also highlight the romantic-evocative and spiritual dimension of the Apulian landscape between the 19th and 20th centuries, through the photographic gaze and travel accounts of artists, poets, geographers and especially architects. A journey that shows how Puglia has been, and continues to be, a laboratory of imagination, a place capable of inspiring narratives, visions and projects.

programme.title: Stand Up Comedy with BeComedy di Marco Di Pinto
programme.description: Stand-Up Comedy with Marco Di Pinto (Becomedy).
longDescription: Marco Di Pinto is a stand-up comedian known for his energetic stage presence and witty, cross-cultural humour. Performing across the UK comedy scene with BeComedy, he combines Apulian roots with British sensibilities, creating a style that is both relatable and refreshingly original.

His comedy moves effortlessly between observational humour and personal storytelling, drawing on cultural contrasts, everyday life, and unexpected perspectives. With a natural ability to connect with audiences, Marco delivers performances that are lively, authentic, and full of character—making him a standout act in contemporary live comedy.

programme.title: An Evening with Gabriella Genisi
programme.venue: Estorick Collection of Modern Italian Art
programme.description: Meet the acclaimed author of the Lolita Lobosco series.
longDescription: Gabriella Genisi, one of Italy's most acclaimed crime writers, brings her latest novel to London as part of the Puglian Italian Fest. In this special event, she will delve into the world of Chicca Lopez, her compelling and unconventional carabiniera, and discuss the inspirations behind her newest noir set in Salento.

Through vivid storytelling and sharp insight, Genisi explores themes of identity, justice, and the complexities of modern Southern Italy, offering audiences a unique glimpse into her creative process and the evolving landscape of Italian crime fiction.
Gabriella Genisi will be joined in conversation by Giorgia Scaturro, multimedia journalist and producer.

Gabriella Genisi — Born in 1965 near Bari, in the Puglia region of southern Italy, Gabriella Genisi is one of the country's most celebrated noir writers. She is best known for her Inspector Lolita Lobosco mystery series — a female answer to Camilleri's Inspector Montalbano, rooted in the warmth and colour of Puglia — which was adapted for Italian television, airing on Rai 1 from 2021 with Luisa Ranieri in the lead role. More recently, she has introduced a second protagonist, Chicca Lopez, a young and rebellious carabiniera whose investigations are set in the Salento region.

Giorgia Scaturro — Giorgia Scaturro is the UK voice for Radio24-ilsole24ore and a News Producer at the RAI bureau in London, she also contributes to programmes such as Porta a Porta. She also writes for Ilfattoquotidiano.it, ELLE, and L'Espresso. Based in London since 2005, she works alongside a range of British and international media outlets, including the BBC, Monocle, and Al Jazeera English. Since 2023, she has served as Social Media Manager for the Foreign Press Association in London.
